processFindings: The positive-handicap thesis correctly measured G2's required future net-kill expansion.
The kill-total model undercounted unresolved towers, dragon cycles, Baron cycles, vision exposure, inhibitor fights, and base defenses.
Functional waveclear delayed the finish but increased the number of later kill opportunities.
Duration suppression and kill suppression must be modeled independently.
Exact kill-total line selection matters; Under 31.5 and Under 28.5 can have different outcomes despite the same broad direction.
The duration central range was too short and should have included an additional objective cycle because towers were 0-0 at 17:59 with near-even gold and functional waveclear on both sides.
modelChanges: Added unresolved map-inventory ledger for totals.
Added map-inventory variance uplift for near-even mid-game states.
Raised Kill Under safety requirement to four kills when the variance uplift is active.
Added numerical Kill Over projection requirements.
Required line-specific comparison across simultaneously available totals.
Added central duration extension rule for late 0-0 or high-structure-depth states.
Added a two-minute numerical official gate for Duration Under.
Made all four market families mandatory in synchronized live output.
